== Description ==

[[Thomas Santosuosso]] at a private table on 22 September 2024, the last day of the [[2024 World Championship]] in Bochum, with a World Championship trophy and the completed Grandezza player-card sets spread in front of him. Two other people at the side table are not yet identified.

== Source and credit ==

* '''Source:''' Star Wars CCG Slack, #2024-worlds-bochum, Thomas Santosuosso (LargePorg), 22 September 2024 (12:29 CEST). Original file name: 1000011859.jpg (2252×4000); Slack file id F07NGRE9ZRR.
* '''Shared by:''' [[Thomas Santosuosso]] (Slack: LargePorg)
* '''Date:''' 22 September 2024 (Slack post date).
* '''Identification:''' [[Thomas Santosuosso]] (foreground, black cap with a yellow logo, light T-shirt): face and cap match [[:File:Tommy Santosuosso 2023 Beezer Bowl.jpg]] and [[:File:Tommy Santosuosso 2023 World Championship.jpg]]; he posted the photograph under the Slack handle LargePorg with the caption that both the red and common Grandezza sets were complete. The two people at the side table are not yet identified.
Unknown faces are listed on [[Unidentified event photographs]]; if you recognise someone, please say so on the [https://swccg.com/forum/viewforum.php?f=4 SWCCG Forum] or this File's Talk page.
